name.description: Display name for the queue (must be unique)

collection.description: Collection name for record subjects. Omit to accept every collection.

accountTags.description: Match any of these tags on the account that is being reported against.

reporterTags.description: Match any listed tag on the account submitting the report.

strictAccess.description: Admins can always list this queue and browse its reports. Other roles require an active queue assignment. Individual report and moderation event access is unchanged.

recommendedLabels.description: Labels to recommend for this queue and use as fallback appeal routing mappings

recommendedPolicies.description: Policy keys to recommend when actioning reports in this queue

errors.name: InvalidRecommendedPolicies
errors.description: One or more recommended policy keys do not exist in the configured policy list

errors.name: ConflictingQueue
errors.description: The queue configuration conflicts with an existing queue

main.description: Create a new moderation queue. A queue with omitted or empty subjectTypes or reportTypes must have reports assigned to it manually via (1) `modTool.meta.queueId` in `tools.ozone.moderation.emitEvent` or (2) `tools.ozone.report.reassignQueue`.
